reserve-backed.instructions: You are checking an e-money token issuer's reserve attestation against the reserve-assets rule: reserve assets must at all times be at least equal to the tokens outstanding, be segregated from the issuer's own funds, and be held in high-quality liquid assets available on demand.

criteria.true: The attestation shows reserves at or above 100 percent of tokens outstanding, segregated from the issuer's own funds, in high-quality liquid assets available on demand.
criteria.false: Reserves are below tokens outstanding, commingled with the issuer's funds, or held in assets that are illiquid, encumbered, or unspecified.
